name: EEGMMIDB
description: EEG motor movement and imagery dataset. 109 subjects (S001-S109) performing 5 runs of 4 tasks each. Tasks: baseline (rest), left hand movement, right hand movement, feet movement, and tongue movement. Each run contains 12 trials. Recorded at 160 Hz with 64 channels (10-10 system).

mi_task.description: Motor imagery task label (4 classes). The experimental condition the subject was instructed to perform.

run_id.description: Run identifier (5-10). Run 5/6 = baseline+left/right hand; 7/8 = feet; 9/10 = tongue.

artifact_annotations.description: Per-trial annotations in .event files marking artifacts (EOG, ECG, EMG)

data_access.checksum_verification: Use PhysioNet's manifest for SHA-256 verification

scientific_status: GROUNDED_TRUTH — MI task labels are genuine experimental conditions
label_derivation: Labels are the actual task the subject was instructed to perform (left hand, right hand, feet, tongue). NOT derived from EEG features. Source: experimental protocol, not signal analysis.
circularity_risk: NONE — labels are assigned before EEG recording based on experimental design
